archetypes.name: stdout-contract
archetypes.rationale: The port preserves machine stdout, sentinels, and marker contracts across shell to Python boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan for stdout, stderr, marker, and sentinel compatibility risks. Check that every shell contract has an equivalent Python test. Focus on `STAGED=`, `REPORT_GATE_SIDECARS_FILE=`, final-summary markers, and failure-report decisions. Cite the plan section and file path for each finding. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: cutover-surface
archetypes.rationale: The hard delete can leave prompt, Makefile, lint, or debug references dangling.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan for missed callers and stale references after deleting the three helpers. Check runtime callers, prompt fences, launcher mappings, harness shards, relevant-check rows, docs, and debug scaffolds. Prefer minimum necessary additions. Cite the plan section and file path for each finding. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: security-boundary
archetypes.rationale: The terminal-state writer validates paths and tokens before artifact writes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan for path confinement, symlink, token, and quiet-log ordering regressions. Check `DESIGN_TMPDIR`, `--failure-detail-log`, `--evidence-ref`, terminal-state replacement, and report filing surfaces. Verify no new arbitrary write or shell injection path appears. Cite the plan section and file path for each finding. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
